values.VAR_INFO_DEFINITION: Soil temperature, gapfilled with MDS (numeric index "#" increases with the depth, 1 is shallowest)
Soil water content, gapfilled with MDS (numeric index "#" increases with the depth, 1 is shallowest)

assumptions: Reported depths used for the available soil records; no undocumented depth change inferred.
Both model liquid and total water are reported; sensor phase sensitivity is not inferred by choosing the better score.
Point values are interpolated from model layer-centre states. Outer half cells are constant. No depths outside model soil are allowed.
Model interval means are trapezoidal endpoint estimates, including the initial state. Sub-interval variation is unresolved.
